eyebrow.zh: 信创 · 离线 · 数据不出内网

headline.zh:
换 coding agent，
不丢它学到的 context
headline.en:
Switch coding agents.
Keep the context they've learned.

sub.zh: 把旧 agent 的会话、记忆和工具配置打包成一个可校验的包，导入新 agent，全程不出内网。
sub.en: Packs your old agent's sessions, memories and tool config into a verifiable bundle, then imports it into the new agent — without anything leaving your intranet.

body.zh: 新 agent 默认拿不到旧 agent 的会话、记忆和工具配置——每次切换都是冷启动。CarryState 把这些一起打包，导入新 agent 直接接着用。
body.en: The new agent starts without the old one's sessions, memories or tool config — every switch is a cold start. CarryState packs all of it and imports it into the new agent, ready to continue.

chips: › 会话 + 记忆 + 工具配置一起迁

body.zh: 没有云、没有账号、不需要联网。整个迁移在两台内网机器之间完成，bundle 走 USB 或内部仓库——契合数据不出境的合规要求。
body.en: No cloud, no account, no network. The whole move happens between two intranet machines; the bundle travels by USB or an internal repo — meeting your data-sovereignty rules.

chips: › 离线打包 · 离线导入
› 无云 · 无账号 · 无联网

body.zh: 每个 bundle 都带完整性校验——导入前先验，被篡改或损坏的 bundle 直接拒收。校验指纹可以直接进合规审计记录。
body.en: Every bundle carries an integrity check — verify before importing, and reject any bundle that was tampered with or corrupted. The fingerprint drops straight into your compliance audit trail.

body.zh: 不同 agent 的状态格式并不一样。CarryState 做格式翻译，导入时落到新 agent 的原生布局——不是简单复制目录，而是导入即生效。
body.en: Different agents store state in different layouts. CarryState translates the format so the import lands in the new agent's native layout — not a raw directory copy, but something that works the moment it lands.

chips: › 落到新 agent 原生布局
› 不是复制目录，是导入即生效

headline.zh: 让你的 agent state 跟着你走
headline.en: Make your agent state travel with you

sub.zh: 开源、MIT、零依赖。拷进内网即可使用。
sub.en: Open source, MIT, zero dependencies. Copy it into your intranet and go.

tag.zh: 信创内网的 agent state porter · 开源 · MIT
tag.en: The agent state porter for airgapped intranets · Open source · MIT
